shared_elements: low relief carving on a vertical rectangular stone slab
profile-facing figures with arms/limbs extended toward the center
plant or vegetal motif (branching, frond-like forms)
band-like horizontal divisions along the top edge
raised outline carving with flat interior surfaces
justification: Both are upright stone panels bearing shallow relief that includes beaked, bird-headed profile creatures and branching plant-like forms, which is the most specific correspondence. But A stacks many small schematic animals in loose registers on a rough, weathered pillar, while B is dominated by a single large, finely detailed winged figure with dense parallel incision beside a formal plant, so the compositional logic and level of craft differ sharply.
